description: Benchmark of Mixed-Integer Linear Programming Formulations for District Heating Network Design is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Jerry Lambert, Amedeo Ceruti (Chair of Energy Systems (TUM)). These zipped files contain the necessary code to reproduce the results from "Benchmark of Mixed-Integer Linear Programming Formulations for District Heating Network Design". Four different linear optimization frameworks are benchmarked in this study in order to compare their computational scaling. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
